subject: prog-ext-ft
title: PROG.EXT.FT.------ACC.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 363 (PMBA-27). PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism) is the subject; ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition), LK-IMP (linkage implications) and PER-DY (perception dynamics). From TRS: EXP-DT (expansion dictates). From EXP-DT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From LK-IMP: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) and APL-DT (application dictates). From PER-DY: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis). From CULT-AF-B: POL-DY (political dynamics).
